$comment: Conformance corpus for POST /api/v1/jobs request bodies.

valid.name: design reference instead of an inline solve
valid.$comment: Protocol 1.10. The design names its geometry, params and load cases, so nothing else belongs beside it. The corpus had no case of this form until a review of #21; the SDK's runtime validator had gone on demanding a solver through the whole of 1.10 as a result.

valid.name: design reference pinned to a revision

invalid.name: geometry with invalid obstacle
invalid.reason: nested geometry validation must run on job requests

invalid.name: both forms at once
invalid.reason: a request carrying a design and a geometry holds two intents, and honouring one silently produces a job whose inputs are not what the caller thinks they are

invalid.name: design reference with parameter overrides
invalid.reason: the design form takes no overrides — to change a parameter, patch the design. Accepted until a review of #21 asked what became of them: the route dropped them and solved the design as written.
